tagline: Upholstered with piped seams, so your dog's own seat looks at home in the living room.
lead: Your dog gets a seat of their own beside yours, with memory foam beneath them and arms to lean on.
value: It replaces the seat your dog really wants, which is yours: upholstered furniture with a back and two arms, on a memory foam base.
intro: Damson is an upholstered orthopaedic dog sofa with a raised back, two sofa arms and a supportive memory foam base. The cover comes off and machine washes. Medium, Large and XL, in Blue, Green, Brown or Grey.
points: Supportive foam where they lie, rather than loose filling that shifts and flattens.
Raised on three sides for a chin, a back or a full sideways lean.
Piped seams and furniture-weight fabric, in four colourways.
Removable and machine washable, following the sewn-in care label.
best_for: Living rooms where the dog bed has to look like it belongs, and dogs who would otherwise be on your sofa.
fit_note: Measure your dog lying on their side, nose to base of tail, and add 15–20cm. The back and arms take up part of the footprint, so between sizes, size up. Ask us for exact measurements.
care: Remove the cover and wash it following the sewn-in care label. Air-dry fully before refitting. Never wash or soak the foam.
seo_title: Upholstered Memory Foam Dog Sofa with Arms | Snoozly
seo_description: A seat of their own beside yours: upholstered orthopaedic dog sofa with memory foam base, back and arms. Medium to XL in blue, green, brown or grey.
